parameters.name: Config
parameters.description:
The configuration of the location blacklist, expressed as a JSON string with the following structure:
- **RegionBlockSwitch**: String type. Required. The switch status of the location blacklist. Valid values:
    - **on**: enabled
    - **off**: disabled
- **Countries**: Array type. Optional. The list of international region codes to block.
    > For more information about international region codes, see [Parameters for China and international regions](~~167926~~).


- **Provinces**: Array type. Optional. The list of China region codes to block.

    > For more information about China region codes, see [Parameters for China and international regions](~~167926~~).

    For example, `[11,12]` indicates Beijing and Tianjin.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance.
> You can call [DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~) to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances.
